reference_observations: 轮廓：原树洞以连贯深棕外线和少量结构线区分大物体，木屋用深本色边界。
形状：圆窗、宽叶和木板略不对称，以圆弧配短折角，不是写实建筑。
色面：蜂蜜黄、明亮草绿、青蓝为主，木与水用大块色面和少量长斑。
高光：原饼干和橙黄UI均只用少量短高光，背景不靠细密刻画。
空间：轻俯视玩具舞台，家具在后方/两侧，中央下部留给真实原拉姆。

images.label: 浆果野餐地
images.prompt: Create ONE opaque four-phase background sheet for a small desktop pet, EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal landscape panels, no gutters or borders. Overall sheet target 2048x1280, each panel 16:10. All panels depict the SAME new BERRY PICNIC ORCHARD from exactly the same elevated camera with identical object positions: top-left morning, top-right noon, bottom-left sunset, bottom-right night. This is clean 2009-era Chinese Flash browser-game scenery. Study attached image1 original hollow-tree room for broad empty stage and flat warm-brown contours, image2 lake cabin for uneven chunky structure and color patches, image3 pet panel for crisp simple fill conventions ONLY (do not copy UI), image4 bear biscuit for the short clear highlight vocabulary ONLY. Do not reproduce any original room. Design: a wide pale honey-yellow wooden picnic platform occupies the ENTIRE lower half, mostly empty; a short red-and-cream folded picnic cloth and round little berry basket sit only at extreme back-left edge; behind them two oversized chunky berry bushes with rounded slightly angular leaf clumps and just a few large red berries. Back-right a low simple wooden bench with ONE yellow cushion and one leaf-shaped hanging lantern from an orchard branch near upper right. Across rear center a cyan-blue glimpse of a little stream and low green hills. Few large objects, no tiny scattered flowers. Warm continuous medium dark-brown outline, slightly irregular rounded shapes with a few short straight cuts, flat opaque saturated areas, only 2-4 HARD-EDGED color areas per material. Wood uses just 2 broad tapered patches and sparse joins, NO realistic grain or striations. Gentle toy-stage overhead perspective, generous central-lower platform free for original pet sprite, bottom16percent low detail. Morning: pale yellow flat light patch and cyan sky; noon: clear cyan/bright green with very short shadows; sunset: peach-coral sky and amber lamp; night: dark blue sky with a few small simple star dots, amber lantern, stage remains warm and legible. Keep layout/camera/furniture shapes EXACTLY SAME in four phases, only time lighting changes. No characters, pets, animals, faces, text, letters, logos, UI, buttons, panel labels, gutters, frames. No watercolor or paper texture, no western storybook paint, no 3D or glossy render, no photographic/volumetric lighting, no blur, no dense gradients, no intricate fantasy props. Edge-to-edge opaque background art.
